import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 70;
    static final int MAXN2 = 50;
    static final int LIMIT = 22;
    static long[][] comb = new long[MAXN + 5][MAXN + 5];
    static int n, m, total, mid_idx;
    static int[] g = new int[MAXN + 5];
    static List<Pair<Long, Integer>>[][] partb = new ArrayList[MAXN2 + 5][MAXN2 + 5];
    static Map<Long, Long>[][] parta = new HashMap[MAXN2 + 5][MAXN2 + 5];
    static long best_ans = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    static long best_cnt = 0;

    static class Pair<U, V> {
        U first;
        V second;
        Pair(U first, V second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static void init_comb() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAXN; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean minimize(Long[] a, Long b) {
        if (a[0] > b) {
            a[0] = b;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static boolean maximize(Long[] a, Long b) {
        if (a[0] < b) {
            a[0] = b;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void dfs_b(int x, int cntA, int cntB, long sum, int mid_idx, int n, int total, int[] g, List<Pair<Long, Integer>>[][] partb) {
        if (x == mid_idx) {
            partb[cntA][cntB].add(new Pair<>(sum, 1));
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 1; i++) {
            if (g[x - 1] != -1 && i != g[x - 1]) continue;
            long tmp = 0;
            if (i == 0) {
                if (cntA > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        tmp += comb[cntA - 1][n - 1] * comb[cntB][j] * comb[total - x][n - j];
                    }
                    dfs_b(x - 1, cntA - 1, cntB, sum + tmp, mid_idx, n, total, g, partb);
                }
            } else {
                if (cntB > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        tmp -= comb[cntB - 1][n - 1] * comb[cntA][j] * comb[total - x][n - j];
                    }
                    dfs_b(x - 1, cntA, cntB - 1, sum + tmp, mid_idx, n, total, g, partb);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void process_parta(int n, int m, int total, int mid_idx, int[] g, List<Pair<Long, Integer>>[][] partb, Map<Long, Long>[][] parta) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                parta[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }
        Long[] init = new Long[]{0L};
        parta[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                Map<Long, Long> currentMap = parta[i][j];
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : new HashSet<>(currentMap.entrySet())) {
                    long uX = entry.getKey();
                    long uY = entry.getValue();
                    if (i + j == mid_idx) {
                        List<Pair<Long, Integer>> list = partb[i][j];
                        int p = lowerBound(list, new Pair<>(-uX, -1));
                        if (p < list.size()) {
                            long val = Math.abs(uX + list.get(p).first);
                            long cnt = uY * list.get(p).second;
                            if (minimize(new Long[]{best_ans}, val)) {
                                best_ans = val;
                                best_cnt = cnt;
                            } else if (val == best_ans) {
                                best_cnt += cnt;
                            }
                        }
                        if (p > 0) {
                            long val = Math.abs(uX + list.get(p - 1).first);
                            long cnt = uY * list.get(p - 1).second;
                            if (minimize(new Long[]{best_ans}, val)) {
                                best_ans = val;
                                best_cnt = cnt;
                            } else if (val == best_ans) {
                                best_cnt += cnt;
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        int p = i + j;
                        for (int k = 0; k <= 1; k++) {
                            if (g[p] != -1 && k != g[p]) continue;
                            int cntA = i, cntB = j;
                            if (k == 0) cntA++;
                            else cntB++;
                            if (cntA <= n + m && cntB <= n + m) {
                                long tmp = 0;
                                if (k == 0) {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                                        tmp += comb[cntA - 1][n - 1] * comb[cntB][l] * comb[total - p - 1][n - l];
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                                        tmp -= comb[cntB - 1][n - 1] * comb[cntA][l] * comb[total - p - 1][n - l];
                                    }
                                }
                                long newKey = uX + tmp;
                                long newVal = uY;
                                Map<Long, Long> map = parta[cntA][cntB];
                                map.put(newKey, map.getOrDefault(newKey, 0L) + newVal);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Pair<Long, Integer>> list, Pair<Long, Integer> target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid).first >= target.first) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        init_comb();
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        String s = br.readLine();
        total = (n + m) * 2;
        mid_idx = Math.max(0, total - LIMIT);
        Arrays.fill(g, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) == 'A') g[i] = 0;
            else if (s.charAt(i) == 'B') g[i] = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAXN2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= MAXN2; j++) {
                partb[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAXN2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= MAXN2; j++) {
                parta[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }
        process_parta(n, m, total, mid_idx, g, partb, parta);
        // Second call to process_parta
        process_parta(n, m, total, mid_idx, g, partb, parta);
        System.out.println(best_cnt);
    }
}
